submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Generate ONE full-size native transparent game animation frame run/W/03, same fire talisman boy, strict WEST facing screen LEFT.
Image1 locks original character identity; image2 locks W side camera; image3 is PRIMARY approved clean rounded bright hand-painted Daoist chibi style, no UI; image4 is THIS BATCH W01 and locks exact framing, scale, head size, costume, prop hand ownership and invisible floor. It is a pose reference, redraw a genuinely NEW successive pose. Do not paste, duplicate, warp or mirror it.
Pose W03, right midstance: FAR RIGHT planted shoe supports weight directly below root and right knee begins extending after compression. NEAR LEFT knee and foot swing forward underneath the hips toward screen LEFT, foot lifted modestly; heel no longer stretched far behind. Both arms pass their neutral pumping positions, NEAR LEFT bell hand low near front-left waist, FAR RIGHT talisman hand moves from rear toward ribs but remains on far side. Visible near left shoulder connects to bell hand, never fan. Continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist, no prop swaps. Torso forward lean left 8 degrees, pelvis returns halfway from compressed to neutral height.
Immutable: brown high ponytail, small red-gem gold crown/red ribbons, big warm amber eyes, round chibi boy face; red/gold fire robe, ivory cuffs, black trousers, red-black-gold shoes, taiji waist buckle. Anatomical RIGHT hand one fan of FIVE red/gold talismans. Anatomical LEFT hand one brass bell with red tassel. Hands naturally grip props at a stable physical point. The SAME canvas scale and root as frame1, no auto-fit to limbs. Natural support compression, no grounded-foot renormalization. No effects, flames, shadow, ground plane, speed lines, labels, extra limbs or prop duplication. Genuine transparent alpha; single square native canvas at least1024 per edge.
